legend.0: Crawl-blocking failures: broken redirects, duplicate hosts both resolving 200, or robots/canonical signals contradicting each other
legend.1: Redirects and robots basically work but real defects leak equity: redirect chains, missing canonicals, or contradictory index headers
legend.2: Correct host canonicalization and robots policy; isolated defects remain, like a blanket X-Robots-Tag on API routes or minor inconsistencies
legend.3: Clean single-hop redirects on every variant and consistent index directives; only cosmetic issues remain
legend.4: Nothing to fix: every variant redirects in one hop, robots and headers deliberate and consistent, canonicals exact on all pages

legend.0: Sitemap missing, invalid, or contradicting robots/noindex directives
legend.1: Sitemap stale or missing a large share of indexable URLs; Google cannot rely on it or its lastmod
legend.2: Sitemap covers most URLs but freshness is unreliable: new posts lag for weeks and lastmod trust is mixed
legend.3: Sitemap closely matches the database with honest lastmod; only occasional lag on brand-new posts
legend.4: Sitemap current within minutes, covers every canonical URL, excludes noindex pages, lastmod always honest

legend.0: Key pages error out or are accidentally noindex
legend.1: Many important pages absent from the sitemap AND weakly linked, so Google discovers them late or never
legend.2: All pages reachable, but discovery depends on crawl luck; no reliable sitemap push for new posts
legend.3: All canonical URLs in the sitemap and internally linked; new posts appear in the sitemap promptly
legend.4: Everything in level three plus indexing actively nudged via IndexNow/GSC requests and verified in Search Console

legend.1: Basic entity schema only (Person/WebSite); article and breadcrumb types missing or erroring
legend.2: Person, WebSite, Organization, BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList present and valid; but no answer-engine types (FAQ, HowTo, Speakable, SearchAction, ItemList)
legend.3: Full set including FAQ/SearchAction/ItemList; minor gaps like HowTo on guides or one type with warnings
legend.4: Gold standard: every eligible type present, valid, entity-linked with @id references, zero errors

legend.0: Content not extractable: walls of narrative with no quotable answers
legend.1: Posts open with narrative; no quotable definition paragraphs, no takeaway boxes, no bylines
legend.2: Some posts open answer-first; takeaways or bylines present on a minority of posts
legend.3: Most posts open with a 1-2 sentence direct answer; key-takeaway boxes and expertise bylines on most posts
legend.4: Every post: answer-first opening, takeaway box, expertise byline, citable stats and definitions throughout

legend.0: Pages are islands with no contextual links
legend.1: Sparse or tag-only linking; no hubs; commercial pages never linked from content
legend.2: Good contextual links across posts plus a homepage hub block, but no pillar page for the main topic cluster
legend.3: Contextual links plus a pillar/hub page linking every spoke; commercial pages linked contextually
legend.4: Full hub-and-spoke: pillar per cluster, series navigation, contextual CTAs, commercial pages linked from every relevant post

legend.0: No web presence beyond the domain itself
legend.1: Zero executed outreach; plans exist but target stale or nonexistent URLs; no earned links; entity limited to social profiles
legend.2: A few profile/directory links live; editorial outreach started but nothing landed
legend.3: Consistent link velocity: several relevant referring domains earned over months; cross-posting with canonicals
legend.4: Recognized topical authority: editorial links from relevant publications, citations in AI answers, strong branded search demand

legend.0: Site effectively invisible: impressions near zero, key pages not indexed
legend.1: Head pages only surface; content pages rarely impress (under ~20 impressions/month site-wide)
legend.2: Content pages surface occasionally for long-tails; average position outside top 20
legend.3: Regular impressions across the cluster; several pages ranking 10-20; brand queries won
legend.4: Top-3 rankings for cluster head terms; growing impressions; featured snippets or AI citations appearing
